meta.description: IQ2GQ Hub - matched syndicate NFL picks against real-world match results and bookmaker odds
meta.source_odds_data: aussportsbetting.com Historical NFL Results and Odds Data (personal use only, not for redistribution - derived/matched data only)
meta.matching_method: Team name canonicalisation (incl. franchise relocations handled via period-correct naming already present in syndicate data) + nearest-date match within +/-8 days of the recorded pick date. One manual one-off override applied (Key 171: New England Patriots H2H, confirmed by syndicate as the 20/01/2013 AFC Championship game rather than the nearer Divisional Round game).
meta.excluded_rows_note: 2 rows excluded for Sport field mistagging (Atlanta Hawks/NBA, Canberra Raiders/NRL, both tagged American Football (NFL) in error). 1 row excluded as a player-only prop pick (Christian McCaffery, no team stated). 7 rows excluded as NFL pre-season picks (August), which fall outside the regular-season/playoff coverage of the odds data source.
